metadata.title: Phase H28 Canonical Accounting & Mathematical Reconciliation

issue_a_token_discrepancy.description: Reconciliation of 23,256 (H27 Surface Inventory) vs 23,258 (Final Corpus Accounting)
issue_a_token_discrepancy.root_cause: Unicode Latin-1 character 'ü' (U+00FC) in Segment #1274 ('His name is Hans Rüsling.'). Python's \b regex boundary treats 'ü' as \w, preventing \b[a-zA-Z0-9']+\b from matching ASCII fragments 'r' and 'sling' which were adjacent to \w, thus dropping 2 tokens. The bcl tokenizer [a-z0-9]+(?:'[a-z0-9]+)? matched both fragments as independent tokens (23,256 + 2 = 23,258).
issue_a_token_discrepancy.resolution: Adopt standardized unicode-aware tokenization rule preserving exactly 23,258 canonical tokens with stable identifiers MXKkXXYUxBc:S0001:T0001 to MXKkXXYUxBc:S2366:T0006.

issue_b_gloss_dispatch_discrepancy.description: Reconciliation of 10,898 generated glosses vs 10,762 playable sign dispatches (136-output difference)
issue_b_gloss_dispatch_discrepancy.root_cause: Multi-word phrase translation rules emitted 7 non-lexicalized or modal glosses lacking corresponding asset IDs in motionCatalog, which were filtered out by translator line 1594 (filter(id => this.motionCatalog[id])).

GOING_TO.linguistic_role: Future aspect marker (should map to WILL in ISL)

MUST.linguistic_role: Modal necessity (should map to NEED in ISL)

ALL.linguistic_role: Universal quantifier (ALL lacks authored motion; ONE is playable)

AGAIN.linguistic_role: Iterative aspect (AGAIN lacks authored motion; MORE is playable)

FOR.linguistic_role: Purposive conjunction (should map to REASON in ISL)
